mainEntity.name: What materials are available for a new deck rebuild?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for deck rebuilding include pressure-treated lumber, cedar, redwood, and composite decking. Pressure-treated lumber is cost-effective and durable, while cedar and redwood offer natural beauty and resistance to rot. Composite decking, made from recycled plastics and wood fibers, provides low maintenance and a long lifespan. When choosing, consider factors like maintenance requirements, desired aesthetic, durability, and budget, which Hometelligent Inc. can discuss with you to match your needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available deck materials include pressure-treated wood, cedar, redwood, and composite decking. Your choice depends on maintenance, aesthetics, durability, and budget.
